workbenchUpdateRecovery.input: Original owner, job ID, revision and immutable command ID/payload.
workbenchUpdateRecovery.acceptance: Validate existing list/job projection and exact persisted command at an advancing revision before retiring pending state.
workbenchUpdateRecovery.failure: Read failure or malformed success retains exact command and private input; different owner cannot dispatch it.
workbenchUpdateRecovery.recovery: Read back the same owner job or explicitly retry the same command, without rerunning the Tool.
workbenchUpdateRecovery.compatibility: Existing API, storage and authorization unchanged; legacy plans pass through existing store normalization.
workbenchUpdateRecovery.limits: Current-page memory; no forced-close persistence or Provider acceptance.

runnerSession.boundary: ownerScope + job ID + step ID; Workbench lifetime memory only
runnerSession.scope: Existing shared citation, free-article and Coconala checker fields/output, plus Delivery review JSON, selected File references and result. Other specialized lazy-runner internal state excluded.
runnerSession.recovery: Restore original input, result and explicit save controls after read failure remount. Late results remain in original session; stale owner/job actions are rejected.
runnerSession.persistence: No implicit localStorage write. Forced reload/tab close still loses unsaved memory; save/export remains explicit.
runnerSession.keyStorage: Map for session snapshots, subscriptions and last opened steps; no external-name property assignment.
runnerSession.feedback: Workbench owns completed Tool recording failures until exact readback; Tool validation/warnings and standalone recording feedback remain local.
runnerSession.navigation: Meaningful shared-Tool input/output/running state joins existing same-tab navigation guard. Original confirmed owner can discard each exact current snapshot by job/step, including cancelled/hidden jobs; pending/running writes and stale/foreign-owner callbacks cannot discard. Saved Library and job records are unchanged. Other-owner identity/details stay hidden; separate-tab links and downloads remain available.
runnerSession.authentication: MR parent or Delivery 401 invalidates Workbench identity and older list generations, masks private details, and retains original memory. Child 200 alone cannot restore it; explicit parent recheck must confirm the original owner.
runnerSession.deliveryExecution: Synchronous lock and current mounted/owner/job/step checks before dispatch, including after file preparation and tracking start. Unknown workflow record blocks stale rerun/discard; already-started late output stays in its original session.

workComposition.input: Owner scoped objective, acceptance criteria, bounded text/CSV and validated finite local Tool graph

workComposition.persistence: Existing owner scoped work_jobs JSON; revision CAS and exact command fingerprint; no migration
workComposition.failureRecovery: Retain original owner/operation on ambiguous response; retry same operation; hide private input on authentication loss; confirmed artifacts survive restart
